items.raw_excerpt: South Australia's doctors' union says it is concerned patient care "is being jeopardised" because of alleged behavioural problems at the Gawler Health Service, but the nurses' union says it has not identified any evidence of systemic bullying.
items.summary_en: Doctors in South Australia are worried about patient care at Gawler Health Service. They say some nurses have behavioral problems. The nurses' union says it found no evidence of bullying.
items.summary_ko: 사우스오스트레일리아 의사들은 까우러 보건소의 환자 안전에 우려를 나타냈다. 일부 간호사들의 행동 문제가 있다고 말했다. 그러나 간호사 노조는 괴롭힘이라는 증거를 찾지 못했다.
items.title_en: Doctors' Union Worries About Nurse Behavior at South Australia Health Service
items.title_original: Doctors' union concerned by nurses' behaviour at SA health service

items.raw_excerpt: IMD forecasts heavy rainfall and strong winds in six Telangana districts on July 28, 2026, with light rain in Hyderabad.
items.summary_en: The India Meteorological Department forecasts heavy rain and strong winds in six Telangana districts on July 28. Hyderabad is expected to receive light rain. Residents should prepare for wet conditions.
items.summary_ko: 인도기상청이 7월 28일 텔랑가나 6개 지역에 폭우와 강풍을 예보했습니다. Hyderabad에는 가벼운 비가 예상됩니다. 주민들은 습한 날씨에 대비해야 합니다.
items.title_en: Heavy rainfall forecast in Telangana districts on July 28
items.title_original: Heavy rainfall forecast in six Telangana districts on July 28

items.raw_excerpt: A former star of Heartbeat has become the new co-owner of the pub known to millions of viewers as The Aidensfield Arms.
items.summary_en: Tricia Penrose, who starred in the TV show Heartbeat, has become the new co-owner of the Goathland Hotel. The pub was known to millions of viewers as The Aidensfield Arms in the popular television series. The hotel is located in the village of Goathland in North Yorkshire.
items.summary_ko: 하트비트 드라마에 출연했던 트리시아 펜로즈가 고스랜드 호텔의 새로운 공동 소유자가 되었다. 이 펍은 인기 TV 시리즈에서 수백만 시청자들에게 에이든스필드 암스로 잘 알려져 있다. 호텔은 노스 요크셔주의 고스랜드 마을에 위치하고 있다.
items.title_en: Former Heartbeat star becomes co-owner of famous Yorkshire pub
items.title_ko: 하트비트 출신 배우, 요크셔 유명 펍 공동 소유자가 되다
items.title_original: The Goathland Hotel: Former Heartbeat star Tricia Penrose becomes co-owner of pub - Yorkshire Post
